exams.name: Certified Associate in Project Management
exams.blurb: Entry PMI credential requiring no leadership experience, covering predictive, agile and business analysis fundamentals.

exams.name: Certified Sustainable Project Professional
exams.blurb: Certification giving project leaders tools to embed sustainability, resilience and long-term value into delivery decisions.

exams.name: Disciplined Agile Foundations
exams.blurb: Course that replaced the retired DASM certification, covering the Disciplined Agile tool kit and team ways of working.

exams.name: Disciplined Agile Leadership
exams.blurb: Course merging the retired DAC and DAVSC certifications, covering value delivery and enterprise agility for leaders.

exams.name: PMI Agile Certified Practitioner
exams.blurb: Framework-agnostic agile certification spanning Scrum, Kanban, Lean and XP, refreshed to absorb Disciplined Agile content.

exams.name: PMI Certified Professional in Managing AI
exams.blurb: Certification built on the CPMAI methodology for running artificial intelligence and data projects through iterative phases.

exams.name: PMI Citizen Developer Practitioner
exams.blurb: Credential covering low-code and no-code application delivery, governance guardrails and citizen development practice.

exams.name: PMI Construction Professional
exams.blurb: Construction-focused certification covering contract management, interface management, scope change and built environment risk.

exams.name: PMI PMO Certified Professional
exams.blurb: Certification covering setting up, assessing, managing and improving value-oriented project management offices.

exams.name: PMI Risk Management Professional
exams.blurb: Certification covering risk strategy, identification, qualitative and quantitative analysis, response planning and monitoring.

exams.name: PMI Scheduling Professional
exams.blurb: Certification covering schedule development, maintenance, analysis and reporting on complex multi-workstream projects.

exams.name: Portfolio Management Professional
exams.blurb: Senior credential for portfolio managers aligning programmes and projects with organisational strategy and investment goals.

exams.name: Program Management Professional
exams.blurb: Advanced credential with a panel review and examination for professionals managing multiple related projects strategically.

exams.name: Project Management Professional
exams.blurb: Flagship project management certification covering people, process and business environment across predictive and agile delivery.

exams.name: Advanced Certified Scrum Product Owner
exams.blurb: Second-level Product Owner credential covering product discovery, validation, stakeholder alignment and value measurement.

exams.name: Advanced Certified ScrumMaster
exams.blurb: Second-level Scrum Master credential requiring experience plus training in facilitation, coaching and scaling practices.

exams.name: Certified Agile Leadership I
exams.blurb: Leadership credential covering organisational agility, leadership mindset, culture and systems thinking for managers.

exams.name: Certified Agile Leadership II
exams.blurb: Advanced leadership credential requiring applied organisational change work validated through a mentored learning journey.

exams.name: Certified Enterprise Coach
exams.blurb: Peer-reviewed guide-level credential for coaches leading agile transformation at organisation and portfolio scale.

exams.name: Certified Scrum Developer
exams.blurb: Credential for developers covering Scrum plus technical practices such as test-driven development and continuous integration.

exams.name: Certified Scrum Product Owner
exams.blurb: Course-based credential covering product vision, backlog management, stakeholder collaboration and release planning.

exams.name: Certified Scrum Professional – Product Owner
exams.blurb: Third-level Product Owner credential requiring advanced training plus documented product ownership experience.

exams.name: Certified Scrum Professional – ScrumMaster
exams.blurb: Third-level Scrum Master credential requiring advanced training plus at least two years of documented practice.

exams.name: Certified ScrumMaster
exams.blurb: Widely held entry Scrum credential requiring an accredited two-day course followed by an online knowledge test.

exams.name: Certified Team Coach
exams.blurb: Peer-reviewed credential validating coaching experience with multiple Scrum teams and demonstrated coaching competencies.

exams.name: Associate Professional in Human Resources
exams.blurb: Entry knowledge-based HR credential with no experience requirement, covering operations, recruitment, compensation and law.

exams.name: Associate Professional in Human Resources – International
exams.blurb: Entry HR credential for professionals outside the United States, covering core HR practice without country-specific law.

exams.name: Global Professional in Human Resources
exams.blurb: Credential covering cross-border HR strategy, global mobility, international employment law and multinational talent practice.

exams.name: Professional in Human Resources
exams.blurb: Operational HR credential covering employee relations, recruitment, compensation, development and United States employment law.

exams.name: Professional in Human Resources – California
exams.blurb: Specialty credential on California-specific employment law, wage and hour rules, and leave requirements for HR practitioners.

exams.name: Professional in Human Resources – International
exams.blurb: Operational HR credential for practitioners outside the United States, focused on generally accepted global HR practice.

exams.name: Senior Professional in Human Resources
exams.blurb: Strategic HR credential covering policy design, workforce planning, organisational effectiveness and executive partnership.

exams.name: Senior Professional in Human Resources – International
exams.blurb: Strategic HR credential for senior practitioners outside the United States covering global policy and leadership practice.

exams.name: Certified Benefits Professional
exams.blurb: Course and examination series covering health, retirement and voluntary benefit plan design, regulation and administration.

exams.name: Certified Compensation Professional
exams.blurb: Multi-examination credential covering job analysis, market pricing, pay structures, incentives and regulatory compliance.

exams.name: Certified Sales Compensation Professional
exams.blurb: Designation covering sales incentive plan design, quota setting, territory alignment and plan governance and audit.

exams.name: Global Remuneration Professional
exams.blurb: Designation covering international pay structures, expatriate remuneration, currency issues and cross-border compliance.

exams.name: Work-Life Certified Professional
exams.blurb: Designation covering flexible work, caregiving support, wellbeing programmes and workplace culture initiatives.
